description: Notification sent to student when their academic misconduct case is updated
subject: Academic Misconduct Case Update - $case_id
body:
Dear $student_name,

This is to inform you that your academic misconduct case ($case_id) has been updated.

The following changes have been made:
$changes_list

Current Case Status: $status
Violation Type: $violation_type
Severity Level: $severity

If you have any questions regarding these changes, please contact the Academic Integrity Office.

Regards,
Academic Misconduct Panel
University Administration
